#   FireHOL IP Blocklist › BotScout (1 day)
#   
#   BotScout helps prevent automated web scripts, known as bots, from
#   registering on forums, polluting databases, spreading spam, and abusing
#   forms on web sites. They do this by tracking the names, IPs, and email
#   addresses that bots use and logging them as unique signatures for future
#   reference.
#   
#   They also provide a simple yet powerful API that you can use to test
#   forms when they're submitted on your site. This list is composed of the
#   most recently-caught bots. 
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malicious data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
